dedupe_keys.name: fuhrlaender fl2500 turbine scada observations and analysis examples

description: The Fuhrländer SCADA research team publishes three years of operating data from five FL2500 2.5-MW wind turbines. The dataset reports minimum, maximum, mean and standard deviation for 78 sensors every five minutes, yielding 312 variables, together with alarm descriptions and affected subsystems. JSON observations cover 2012–2014 and are packaged with R and MATLAB access functions and an example extreme-learning-machine classifier. Access is free, but Figshare archive metadata states MIT while the current GitHub repository states EPL-2.0. These data can calibrate component-condition and availability simulations that supply wind-generation assumptions to model-pypsa. A caveat is that the observations describe one turbine design and installation, not a representative fleet. Acquisition failures and alarm interpretation need separate checks. The licence difference is retained, and no archive or classifier was executed.
